title: He Nailed His Family Inside A Basement . . .

segments.say: Kids were dying outside this door, and this dad *refused* to open it.
His own daughter begged him. He grabbed her and said this.

segments.text: If you go out there, I'll kill you.

segments.say: But here is the crazy part. He might have been *right*.
A *nuclear missile* was coming, so Jack ran his family into the basement and *nailed* the door shut.
Then the neighbor knocked. Her kids were *sick*. Jack refused to open.
Weeks later, the radio said the radiation had dropped. So they made *armor* and went up.
Then everything went *black*. Back down, Anna got a fever. And one night, she stopped *answering*.
Days later, she *opened* her eyes, and asked how long it had been. Jack *lied*.
The next morning, they opened the door to a *blinding* light.
Anna had not moved for *days*. Now she was walking out that door with them.
But remember the phone that still worked? And the helicopter? What if there was *never* a bomb at all?
Comment *bomb* or *no bomb*. I will tell you the truth.
